reviews.text: We can’t recommend Jean highly enough. She took such good care of our 2 cats, sending us daily updates and spending a quality amount of time with them so that we felt reassured that they were cared for and had someone to chat to and play with while we were away.

We couldn’t have asked for anyone better than Jean to look after our elderly cat while we were away. She was absolutely wonderful with her and took great care to make sure she was happy, comfortable and well looked after.

Jean also gave her daily medication, which gave us real peace of mind knowing she was in such capable and caring hands. We especially loved receiving all the lovely videos and updates while we were on holiday – it was so reassuring to see her looking happy and settled.

Thank you so much, Jean, for taking such great care of her. We would have no hesitation in recommending you and will definitely be asking you to look after her again! ❤️

I am delighted to wholeheartedly recommend Jean for caring for my two beloved cats. Jean’s professionalism truly stood out, as Jean consistently kept me informed with daily updates on my cats’ wellbeing and activities. Jeans thoughtful approach went beyond routine care—Jean made a point to engage with the cats, playing with them, talking gently, and ensuring they felt safe and comfortable in my absence. Lillian, one of my cats, is notoriously shy, yet Jean’s patience was unwavering. Jean took the time to reassure Lillian, carefully searched for her favorite hiding spots, and never hesitated to offer extra attention and comfort. Jean’s dedication and genuine compassion made a world of difference, and I am sincerely grateful for the care Jean provided. I couldn’t be happier with Jean’s service, and I strongly recommend them to anyone seeking reliable, attentive, and loving care for their pets.

I honestly can’t recommend Jean at CatCareBrum highly enough.

Leaving my two cats, Happy and Hope, is never easy, especially because one of them has a history of medical issues. From the very first meet and greet, Jean put my mind completely at ease. She was kind, knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely interested in getting to know both of my cats and their individual personalities.

During every visit, she sent me detailed updates, photos and videos, which meant the world to me. I could see that Happy and Hope were relaxed, happy, and receiving so much love and attention. It was obvious that Jean wasn’t just popping in to feed them, she truly cared about them.

I came home to two calm, happy cats and a spotless house. Everything had been looked after perfectly, and I honestly don’t think I could have asked for a better experience.

Jean is reliable, professional, trustworthy, and has a genuine love for cats that shines through in everything she does. If you’re looking for someone to care for your cats as if they were her own, look no further.

She gave me complete peace of mind while I was away. She is simply the best cat sitter I could ever have hoped for, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend CatCareBrum to anyone.

I would definitely recommend Cat Care Brum. Jean looked after our very nervous cat for three days while we were away, which is the longest we’ve ever left Callie. From the very beginning, the whole process was so easy, and Jean was really laid back, approachable, and reassuring, which made us feel completely at ease.

Jean came to meet us and Callie before we went away, and while we were away she sent us regular photos and videos, which was lovely and gave us real peace of mind. It was clear that Callie was being well looked after.

I’ll definitely be asking Jean to help out again in the future!
I would highly recommend Jean. She is very reliable and also knowledgable about cats. Updates are thorough and show how much care Jean takes. I came home to a happy cat.
